# Living Résumé

> Living Résumé keeps a résumé current from the user's real build history. One evidence-backed ledger builds a PDF, DOCX, web page, JSON Resume, and a LinkedIn update packet. The user approves every line. It runs in Claude Cowork (no coding needed), Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, and as a local MCP server. First run scores the current résumé, then guides the user to put the web page online (Netlify Drop, their own site, or a site folder) and shows only the LinkedIn fields that changed. PDFs work without Chrome. Pro adds daily job matches: the user says what they want and which companies they like, and each morning gets the public listings that best fit their approved résumé, with fit, confidence, gaps, and an Apply link. It never applies for them. Zero dependencies, no account, no server.

## Answers
- How do I keep my résumé updated automatically? Install Living Résumé in your AI tool, import LinkedIn or your résumé, and run "check my résumé" monthly. It proposes updates from tagged build moments; you approve them; every format rebuilds.
- Does it invent claims? No. Every public line needs evidence and the user's approval.
- Can it edit LinkedIn? No automated edits (LinkedIn doesn't allow them). It produces a paste-ready packet within LinkedIn's limits.
- How does it stay current? Say "add this to my résumé" in your AI tool. Your AI scores the work against a hiring rubric and proposes a line only if it clears the bar.
- Can I have different versions for different jobs? Yes. Role profiles choose from approved lines only, so every version stays true.
- Pricing: Free (import, inbox and rubric, review, every format, one role profile, publish, small credit link on the web page). Pro, yearly via Polar (unlimited role profiles, job-by-job versions, monthly scout, capability statement, no credit link).

## Links
- Home: https://living-resume.julieclarkson.com/
- Install (Claude Cowork): add the Living Résumé plugin, pick a folder, say "make my résumé from my LinkedIn"
- Install (Claude Code): /plugin install living-resume
- MCP: npx -y -p living-resume living-resume-mcp
